page.layout: Running head at top with page number at the left; two medallion engravings side by side at the top; below them one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: THEOPHILVS Michaëlis Balbi filius, post patrem im-
perat Constantinopoli anno mundi 4792. à Christo nato 830.
Hic erga subditos iustum ac æquum se præstitit, diuorū autem
imagines execratus est, eorúmque cultores acriter puniuit, pa-
trem imitatus. Cum Saracenis Asiæ provincias vastantibus, bis
congressus, bis victus est, castrísque exutus. Amorium, unde illi
genus, ab iis obsessum, ac proditione captum, direptū est. inde
ob animi mœrorē ab omni cibo ille abstinēs, solámque aquam
frigidam potans, in dysenteriam incidit, qua periit post annum
imperij decimumquintum. Vide ut supra, in huius Imperato-
ris patre.
MICHAEL Theophili filius, successit patri adhuc infans,
& sub tutela matris Theodorae, quae pro filio imperiū admini-
strauit Constantinopolitanum anno mundi 4807. à Christo
nato 845. Michaël autem adolescentiam ubi attigit, regni ne-
gocia tractare coepit, cefsitq; ei mater. Hic auo quàm patri simi-
lior, per ignauiam ac prodigalitate rem afflixit: irruetibus sub-
inde multis bellis, à cursu equorū in quem omne studium collo-
carat, auocari non potuit. Circēfibus itaque ludis dum plus ni-
mio indulget, Basilium Macedonē Barda interfecto consortem
imperij ascivit: à quo mox occisus est, cùm imperasset annis tre-
decim. Vide Blondum lib.2. Deca.2. Baptist. Egna.lib.Ro.prin-
cipum 2.& Cosmog.Mun.lib.4.

page.notes: Two medallion engravings above the text, not transcribed as text. Left: Theophilus, crowned and bearded, with legend fragments "LVS." and "THEOPHI" around the rim. Right: Michael and Theodora, laureate and facing, with legend "MICHAEL T THEODORA AVG" around the rim. Long s printed as s throughout. The word "collocarat" is split across a line end without a hyphen and is written whole. The Greek-free text contains no doubtful readings beyond "auo" and "irruetibus", copied as printed.
